output_list.criticism: The initialSupply is defined as 100000000, and the totalSupply is increased by mintedAmount in the mintToken function, without any overflow check. This can be exploited by an attacker to mint arbitrary large amount of tokens owned by the attacker, and can also cause a denial of service by making the totalSupply impossibly large.

The function decreases the balanceOf[_from] by _value, and increases the balanceOf[_to] by _value, without any overflow check. If _value is large enough, the balanceOf[_from] will be set to zero, and the attacker can cause a denial of service to the _from user.

The transfer function calls the _transfer function, and the _transfer function has an integer overflow vulnerability. If the balanceOf[msg.sender] is small, and _value is large, the balanceOf[msg.sender] will be set to zero, and the attacker can cause a denial of service to the msg.sender.
